title: Probably the WORST assembly instructions I have ever seen
text:
Probably the WORST assembly instructions I have ever seen. The instructions aren't bad, they are PATHETIC. Instructions included directions to assemble parts that were already assembled. Instructions left out assembly of parts that were not assembled. Instructions skipped two steps that required complete disassembly to step 2. Instructions had no mention, much less instructions about wheel assembly or battery installation for the ignitor.

If you want to waste an hour more than necessary putting something together, taking it apart and then putting it back together this might be for you.

The manufacturer should have to pay me for the time wasted due to worthless instructions. I seriously could have done it faster without any instructions at all.
